issues.reason: Elemental Summoner subtype has exactly six candidate choices; wizard does not yet bind race-specific choice events.
Mist Sight has exactly three alternatives but grants only one; its use counter and selection need wizard support.
Four Viera heritages substitute the full racial scores and People of the Wood skill bonuses; block until reviewed.
Fleet-Footed and Spirit of the Waters both replace Weapon Familiarity, creating a conflict.
Conditional magic bonuses, optional Aquan language, and class-favored fractional choices remain manual.

features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 WIS, -2 CON

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium size; no inherent size adjustment.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with viera subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30-foot land speed.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begin speaking Common and Vieran. High-INT optional languages: Banganese, Elvaan, Lalafellan, Mithran, Moogle, Numish, Seeq.

features.name: Vieran Immunities
features.description: Immune to magical sleep, plus +2 racial saves against enfeebling spells and effects.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: +2 racial Perception.

features.name: Hunter
features.description: Stealth and Survival are always class skills.

features.name: People of the Wood
features.description: +1 racial Knowledge (nature) and Survival.

features.name: Elemental Summoner
features.description: At character creation choose earth, fire, ice, lightning, water or wind; summoning a creature with that subtype increases spell duration two rounds; retraining required to change.

features.name: Vieran Magic
features.description: +2 caster-level checks to overcome spell resistance and +2 racial Spellcraft specifically to identify magic item properties.

features.name: Weapon Familiarity
features.description: Proficient with shortbow and longbow (including composite), greatbow and orc hornbow.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far as humans in dim light.

features.name: Fleet-Footed
features.description: Gain Run as bonus feat, plus +2 initiative.

features.name: Mist Sight
features.description: Choose exactly one: detect magic, detect secret doors, or detect undead, as a 3/day spell-like ability at character level.

features.name: Misted Bows
features.description: Bow of the Viera spell-like ability 1/day at character level.

features.name: Misty Mind
features.description: +2 racial Will saves against enfeebling charm/compulsion; second save 1 round after failed check for ongoing effects, limited by similar reroll features.

features.name: Silent Hunter
features.description: Reduce movement Stealth penalty by 5 and can use Stealth while running at -20 total.

features.name: Spirit of the Waters
features.description: +4 Swim, always take 10 swimming, may choose Aquan language, proficient with longspear, trident, and net.

features.name: Urbanite
features.description: +2 Diplomacy gathering information and Sense Motive getting social hunch (not global bonuses).

features.name: Fanow Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 WIS, -2 STR

features.name: Fanow Heritage Benefit
features.description: +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (History), Stealth instead of Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Rak'Tika Greatwoods lineage with alternative racial skill modifiers.

features.name: Feol Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 INT, -2 CON

features.name: Feol Heritage Benefit
features.description: +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (Local), Knowledge (Engineering) instead of Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Aegyl-descended variant with alternative skill modifiers.

features.name: Mist-Frenzied Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 STR, +2 CHA, -2 INT

features.name: Mist-Frenzied Heritage Benefit
features.description: +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (Arcana), Intimidate instead of Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Mist-exposed variant with alternative skill modifiers.

features.name: Rava Heritage Ability Scores
features.description: +2 DEX, +2 CHA, -2 CON

features.name: Rava Heritage Benefit
features.description: +1 racial bonus on Knowledge (Planes), Handle Animal instead of Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Golmore Jungle lineage with alternative skill modifiers.
